transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve been having a hard time keeping up with basic things. Like paying bills, answering interview emails, getting to appointments, errands. I keep forgetting or not following through, and it’s started costing me opportunities.
Did you have similar problems with focus, organization, or follow-through when you were a child?

Yeah… I think so. In elementary school, teachers would say I was bright, but I was always losing worksheets or not following directions carefully. I’d rush through things, talk when I wasn’t supposed to, and my desk was… really messy. Like, I couldn’t find assignments sometimes.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on a task, even when you want to do it?

Yeah. I’ll sit down meaning to do something, like update my resume or work on a coding practice problem, and then… a text pops up, or I hear someone outside, or I remember some other thing I need to do. And I’m just off it before I even realize I stopped.
Do these focus and follow-through problems also show up in your daily life outside of school or work?

Yeah. That’s actually kind of why I came in. I keep messing up basic stuff… like paying bills, replying to interview emails, getting to appointments, errands. I’ll mean to do it and then it just doesn’t happen, and it’s starting to cost me actual opportunities.
Have these problems with focus and follow-through been present pretty consistently since childhood?

Yeah… pretty much. I mean, even in elementary school, teachers would write that I was bright, but I was always losing worksheets or rushing through directions. I’d talk out of turn, and my desk was so messy I couldn’t find assignments sometimes.
Do these problems affect you in more than one part of your life, like work, home, or relationships?

Yeah… it’s not just one area. Since I got fired, I’ve missed follow-ups for interviews, and I had to step back from a volunteer project I actually cared about. So now I’m unemployed, and it feels like I can’t really manage the basic steps to move things forward.
Have you been feeling depressed most days?
I don’t think so. I mean… I get frustrated and down about things, but depressed most days? I’m not really sure I’d say that.
Do you often feel very anxious or worried?
Um… not really, I don’t think. I worry about stuff when it’s happening, but I wouldn’t say I feel anxious all the time.
Do you often feel physically restless, like it’s hard to sit still?

Yeah… pretty often. If I’m stuck sitting through an interview or a meeting, even a movie, I get this kind of pressure in my body, like I need to move or do something with my hands. It’s hard to just sit there.
Have these attention problems caused serious difficulties in your work or school life?

Yeah… I think so. Since I got fired, it’s been hard to keep up with the basic stuff. I’ve missed follow-ups for interviews, and I had to step back from a volunteer project I actually cared about. So… I’m not working, and it feels like I can’t really manage the steps to move forward.
Did these concentration and organization problems begin only after a medical problem or head injury?

No… I don’t think so. It goes way back. Like, even in elementary school my teachers would write that I was bright, but I was always losing worksheets, rushing through directions, talking when I shouldn’t, and my desk was… really messy. I couldn’t find assignments a lot.
Do these attention and organization problems also happen at home?

Yeah… at home too. Like if I’m trying to clean or do some application thing, I’ll start and then… it just doesn’t get finished. I’ll have forms half done, emails I meant to send, or piles of stuff I moved around but didn’t actually put away.
Have these focus and restlessness problems caused difficulties in your relationships?
Um… I’m not really sure. I guess maybe sometimes, but I don’t know if I’d say it’s caused major problems. I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Have you been getting less interest or pleasure from things you usually enjoy?
I… don’t think so? I mean, I haven’t really noticed that. I still like the same things, I guess.
